description: Fix the Dependabot vulnerabilities: upgrade Next.js to 15.5 and React to 19, remove unused vulnerable packages, and refresh vulnerable transitive packages.

userStories.title: Upgrade Next.js to 15.5 and React to 19
userStories.description: As the site owner, I want Next.js on the latest 15.5.x release so that the upgrade resolves the critical and high alerts on `next`.
acceptanceCriteria: `package.json` pins `next` and `eslint-config-next` to the same 15.5.x version, at least `15.5.24`.
`package.json` sets `react` and `react-dom` to `^19`, and `@types/react` and `@types/react-dom` to `^19`.
`src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` types `params` as `Promise<{ slug: string }>` and awaits `params` in `generateMetadata` and in `BlogPost`.
`npm ci`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run build` exit 0.
`npm ls next react react-dom` reports one version of each package and no `invalid` or `ERESOLVE` line.

userStories.title: Remove unused packages and refresh the vulnerable transitive packages
userStories.description: As the site owner, I want unused vulnerable packages removed and the other vulnerable packages updated so that `npm audit` reports no high or critical finding.
acceptanceCriteria: `package.json` no longer lists `jsdom`, `isomorphic-dompurify`, `dompurify`, `html-react-parser`, or `react-input-mask`, nor `@types/react-input-mask`. `git grep` finds no import of these packages in `src/`, `scripts/`, or `next.config.mjs`.
`mermaid` is at least `11.16.1` and `webpack` is at least `5.94.0` in `package-lock.json`.
`npm audit --audit-level=high` exits 0, or `.agro/tasks/dependabot-vulns/evidence/audit.md` records a reason for each remaining high or critical finding.
Each `overrides` entry in `package.json`, if any, names a package for which no parent release carries the fix. `audit.md` records the reason.
`npm ci`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run build` exit 0.

userStories.title: Record the manual review evidence
userStories.description: As the reviewer, I want screenshots and an audit transcript so that I can confirm that the site still renders after the upgrade.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/dependabot-vulns/evidence/home.png` and `.agro/tasks/dependabot-vulns/evidence/pricing.png` show `/` and `/pricing` rendered by `npm start` on the task branch.
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill.

`.agro/tasks/dependabot-vulns/evidence/manual-review.md` records the commands `npm ci`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build`, and `npm audit --audit-level=high`, with each exit status and the `npm audit` severity counts before and after.
The `npm start` process stops after the screenshots.
